Why go: space and shade on a big catamaran

At 52 ft with four air-conditioned cabins, two bathrooms, trampolines at the bow and a covered saloon, Vivienne is one of the most spacious sailing catamarans you can charter for a day on Koh Samui. Catamarans sit flat in the water, so they suit guests who would feel every wave on a speedboat.

The morning half day is the calmest option; the sunset half day gives you the best light; the full day crosses to Koh Phangan for a beach at Haad Rin or the quieter cove of Haad Yuan.

Making the most of the day

The cabins are useful for changing, shade and a nap on the way back, and the trampolines at the bow are the best place to watch the coast slide past. A sashimi platter and snacks are served on board; for a proper meal, order the Thai BBQ or bring your own food for the grill, since there is no corkage. Bring towels. On the full day to Koh Phangan, Haad Yuan is quieter than Haad Rin and only reachable by boat or a steep track, so it is worth choosing if your group wants a calm beach.

Who it suits

  • Families and groups of 6–8 who want shade, beds and bathrooms.
  • Couples celebrating an anniversary or proposal.
  • Groups up to 24 for a party or company outing, with the extra-guest fee.

Who should choose something else

  • Anyone who wants a fast day to several islands: see private speedboats.
  • Budget travellers: a shared Pig Island tour costs far less.

Good to know

  • Wind: sailing depends on wind; the engines keep you on time.
  • Lunch: order the Thai BBQ when you book or bring a picnic.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
